messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up for last night's KV OOM. I'm consolidating remediation items so we don't lose track. Please ack + add ETAs if you're owning something.

ajay: Acked. I can take the profiling hooks and pprof captures. Need the repro workload and the instance ids.

devon: I can run the targeted repro on my perf cluster. Is the input distribution the same as prod (high prefix churn + long tail keys)?

maria: yes — same distribution. repro script: `scripts/repro/kv_frag_repro.sh` (use --scale=10 for heavier churn). Instance ids from last incident: i-0a12f, i-0b34c (logs linked: https://internal/logs/incident/177889)

ajay: grabbing logs now. I'll add an automated pprof hook to the crash handler and a periodic heap snapshot (every 6h) behind a flag. Patching in eng-runtime repo.

maria: ACTIONS (from thread):
- ajay: add pprof dump on OOM + scheduled heap snapshots (flagged, rollout canary) — ETA Tue EOD
- devon: run repro + produce fragmentation heatmap + root-cause notes — ETA Mon 12:00
- maria: propose compaction cron and conservative kv_limit thresholds; draft hotfix config — ETA Wed 09:00
- kate: customer impact blurb + comms if we need a customer-facing note — ETA Mon EOD
- ci-bot: create recurring alert when kv_fragmentation_ratio > 0.65 for 3m — owner eng-sre

kate: copying product/CS — we should decide if any customers hit 5xxs or degraded latencies. I can run the dashboard and summarize.

ci-bot: Deploy pipeline triggered: patch/pprof-heaphook -> canary on d-prod (job 4829). Logs will be posted to #eng-runtime-deploys.

ajay: Quick config snippet I'll try in canary (comments inline):
```
# tentative: reduce kv_soft_limit to avoid OOM path
kv_soft_limit = 0.72  # fraction of heap
kv_compact_interval = 4h
kv_compact_max_pause_ms = 200
# enable scheduled snapshots
enable_heap_snapshots = true
heap_snapshot_interval = 6h
```

devon: Found a pattern in the repro: small-churn prefixes cause many micro-allocs that don't get reclaimed quickly, leading to fragmentation. Heap sample attached (s3://perf/artifacts/177890/frag-map.png). Suggest adding a compact-on-threshold strategy.

maria: Noted. Also flagging recurrence: this is similar to the March incident where frag ratio hit 0.7 before OOM. We should track recurrence in the incident tracker and add a recurring mitigation item.

ajay: Will add a telemetry metric: kv_fragmentation_90p and kv_alloc_gaps_count. Add a Grafana alert + a PagerDuty runbook link.

maria: Agree. Planning check-ins: daily check for the next 5 days, then tri-weekly until we see stable numbers. Who can own the daily check?

devon: I can own daily checks for first 3 days (compare frag ratio vs baseline + confirm pprof samples collected).

kate: I'll own the customer comms and escalate if we see >1% increased error budget for any customer.

maria: Great. I'll create a consolidated ticket in our tracking board with subtasks and owners. Ticket: RDW-2331 (internal). I'll post updates here.

ajay: One more immediate mitigation: limit concurrent KV writes per shard to reduce allocation spikes (50% throttle) — can be toggled via runtime flag. I'll open a quick PR and set canary.

maria: Thanks. If anyone finds a strong repro step that causes 10%+ frag increase quickly, drop it here. Otherwise, we'll meet tomorrow 10:30 to review first-day data. :thumbsup:
